Data Controller Responsible for data processing on this website: PlayPals demo team Example Street 1, 12345 Sample City Email: hello@example.com 2. Data We Collect Game data The games on this site run in your browser. Your player name, the cards you build and your scores are kept in your browser while you play and are not sent to us. Technical data When you open the site, your browser sends technical information such as your IP address, browser type and the time of the request to the web host. This is needed to deliver the pages and to keep the service secure. These logs are deleted automatically after a short time. Local storage We use your browser's local storage to remember your language, sound volume, last game settings and your name. This data never leaves your device and you can delete it at any time in your browser settings. Custom text Items you type into event cards stay on your device. Please do not enter personal information about other people. 3. How We Use Your Data We use the data described above only to: Run the games and remember your preferences Deliver the pages securely Find and fix technical problems 4. Legal Bases for Data Processing Where data protection law applies, we process data on these legal bases: Performance of a contract — providing the games you choose to play Legitimate interests — secure and reliable delivery of the website Consent — any optional feature that asks for your permission first 5. International Data Transfers This demo does not send game data to other countries. If the site is hosted with a provider outside your country, the provider only receives the technical data needed to deliver the pages and is bound by appropriate safeguards. 6. Cookies & Local Storage This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. The only items stored are the preferences listed in section 2, which are strictly necessary for the features you use. You can clear them at any time: Language preference Audio volume and mute setting Your player name Last used game settings Locally saved problem reports 7. Third-Party Services Fonts are bundled with the site and loaded from our own server, so no font provider receives your IP address. No analytics, advertising or social media scripts are embedded. 8. Data Retention Local storage stays on your device until you delete it. Server logs kept by the web host are removed automatically after a short period, usually within 14 days. 9. Your Rights Depending on where you live, you may have the following rights: Right of access to the data we hold about you Right to correct inaccurate data Right to have data deleted Right to restrict processing Right to data portability Right to object to processing Right to complain to a data protection authority To use any of these rights, contact hello@example.com. 10. Data Security Pages are delivered over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). Because game data stays on your device, it is only as safe as the device itself — use a screen lock on shared computers. 11. Children's Privacy The site does not knowingly collect personal data from children. Parents who believe their child entered personal data can clear the browser storage or contact us. 12. Changes to This Policy We may update this policy when the site changes. The date at the top shows the latest version. 13. Contact Questions about privacy?
